subject.title: feat(self-host): local console sign-in without Cloudflare Access

question: Should the officially supported self-host profile include an opt-in local browser-session mode authenticated by the existing shared admin token?
rationale: The patch is a new supported authentication mode rather than a repair to an existing contract; deciding its long-term security and operational support boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in local sessions
options.body: Accept the self-host console as an explicitly enabled shared-admin-token feature, subject to confirming the implementation and proof on the reviewed head.

options.title: Keep self-host API-only
options.body: Retain the current bearer-token administration posture and close or redirect this feature until a different self-host identity model is selected.

recommendation.title: Sponsor opt-in local sessions
recommendation.body: Accept the self-host console as an explicitly enabled shared-admin-token feature, subject to confirming the implementation and proof on the reviewed head.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged self-host profile and its documented API-only boundary originated in the prior self-host deployment work.
